sophia: quick review: compact autoscale row prototype in figma — added burst cap badge + min/max steppers. looking for quick a11y/copy notes. link: https://www.figma.com/file/.../compact-autoscale jamal: main a11y issue: users can tab to +/- but not the numeric value; screen readers may not announce updates. need role="spinbutton" and keyboard handlers. alex: UX q: inline burst badge vs reveal panel? inline is faster but could clutter mobile. kevin: implementation: use a div role="spinbutton" tabindex=0 and handle ArrowUp/Down. add aria-live region for cost updates. example:
2
maya: copy: prefer 'Burst cap' label + helper: 'Temporary capacity above your max for short spikes. Billed at burst rate; auto reduces.' short alt: 'Temporary burst above max (billed).' sophia: also visual nits: focus ring barely visible on dark token; bump to 3px and ensure 3:1 contrast for inactive labels at narrow widths. jamal: SLO slider changes cost preview but nothing announced. add aria-live="polite" region: 'Estimated cost: $X/hr' and ensure badge exposes exact value on focus. kevin: i'll prototype keyboard flow + focus rings and drop a short screencast. tagging @maya for final copy. sophia: great. action items: kevin = keyboard prototype, jamal = live region copy + QA, maya = finalize tooltip text. will open UX PR after prototype. :thumbsup:
